response.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM telescopes AS t2 WHERE t2.observstation = t.observstation AND t2.equipstatus = 'Maintenance') GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;
